locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the source-normalized zero-integral prolate columns and their actual Gram are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), logarithmic Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi); e_t(x)=exp(i*t*x)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is physical reflection x->-x; additive-Fourier residue classes are not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained at the inclusive endpoint, and lambda is never confused with lambda^2
locked_conventions.central_weight: central capture is charged by the compressed Fourier covariance T_B, not by an unweighted worst principal angle
locked_conventions.exterior_levels: level sets are formed from the complete combined archimedean-minus-prime symbol before any spectral tail or interval-component estimate
locked_conventions.spectral_endpoint: the effective-rank count uses the open threshold eta>sigma; eta=sigma remains in the low spectral tail
locked_conventions.odd_direction: the exact odd pole vector is retained separately from the economical central polynomial feature space
locked_conventions.strictness: a finite regression, rank count, nonpositive margin, equality at load one, or a big-O label without a proved constant is not a pass
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and decimal precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 inputs and JSON floating-point numbers are rejected
locked_conventions.input_limits: producer and verifier admit only lambda_numerator in {5,9} and dps in {80,160}; exact text membership is checked before integer conversion or interval initialization
locked_conventions.runtime_version: the interval runtime must report mpmath==1.4.1 exactly; a mismatch is rejected before any interval probe
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact weighted-central, exterior k-width/effective-tail, and odd edge/Chebyshev regressions plus outward interval formula probes; no physical alignment or asymptotic signed floor is certified
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; pi, logarithms, exponentials, square roots, factorial tails, interval-union constants, and Chebyshev remainders use outward mpmath.iv intervals

locked_formulas.weighted_central_cross_gram: G=U^*U, C=U^*T_B U, A=W^*W, S=G-U^*W A^dagger W^*U, and rho_B=tr(G^dagger C G^dagger S)=||P_H P_V T_B^(1/2)||_HS^2
locked_formulas.canonical_central_decomposition: tr(P_H T_B P_H)=sum_j theta_j||P_H u_j||^2 and Tail_r(T_B)<=tau_r
locked_formulas.economical_central_order: r_L=ceil(c*L/log(L)), c>1/4, gives tau_r=lambda^(-4*c+o(1))=o(lambda^-1); this is not an odd-pole approximation
locked_formulas.interval_component_bound: b(y)=8*y-y^2 for 0<=y<=2 and b(y)=12+8*log(y/2) for y>=2; chi_Omega<=sum_a b(L*ell_a)/(4*pi^2)
locked_formulas.sharp_first_moment: load<=U_1=2*mu_p/h-2*d_1/(h*q), d_1=<p,Yp>; U_1<1 iff d_1>q*(mu_p-h/2), but this is not an iff test for the true load
locked_formulas.chebyshev_tail: absolute truncation error after k is at most 2*mu_p/h*(1+sqrt(h/q))*varrho^(k+1), with varrho<(q-h)/q
locked_formulas.claim_separation: effective spectral tails do not prove physical alignment, target Fourier conditioning does not prove arithmetic-prolate capture, and a finite Chebyshev upper bound is not an actual odd reserve until its physical moments and shifted base are proved
